notes.title: New!Tower Defense Mode Coming......
notes.notes:
A new tower defense mode is about to arrive, which will be exciting.
In the new mode, players will need to allocate their resources reasonably, continuously develop the base, and mine resources. Of course, don't forget to improve technology. Technology determines the upper limit of a player's building level. And the combat effectiveness of the player's army. All units and buildings can be automatically repaired with sufficient resources provided by you. Of course, remember to build more arsenal, and you will need it very much because ammunition is also a resource you have. When all ammunition is depleted, all your ranged units can only sadly use their fists to attack zombies. Of course, if you are already a melee unit, you don't have to consider ammunition. Just like reality, the military needs first aid kits to treat wounded soldiers. You need to build first aid kits before the military can automatically restore health. So, ensuring sufficient reserves of ammunition and first aid kits is an important guarantee to prevent the collapse of the military. The basic tower defense system has been completed by 80%, and the rest is map editing and unit model production. The update is expected to be released in January and will be continued if it is not completed yet

notes.title: About Remake Information
notes.notes:
After some consideration, I think it may be better to position the genre direction of remastered games as pure survival games. Because if I were to survive in the form of the original plot, I feel that my current level and manpower are extremely inappropriate. To make a good plot, the first step is to have a very good story, as well as better level design, sound effects, models, particles, and so on. Even QTE is a part that needs to be considered. But all of this is a huge challenge for me at the moment. A person's power is very limited, and if we prioritize it, it will also greatly reduce the player's experience of the plot and gaming experience. For example, the original version is an example where there is no money to purchase good models, animations, sound effects, and everything can only be made by oneself. But if it is made into a pure survival type, I think we can supplement the shortage of artistic resources by strengthening the content of gameplay. Alright, let's talk about the content of reprinting now!
1. In terms of language, we plan to support three languages: "Chinese, Russian, and English"
2. Add a multiplayer Steam online feature (I'm not sure if it can be developed smoothly)
3. Integrate some zombie elements and so on
I haven't figured out the rest, that's all for now. Of course, if you ask me when the remake will be completed, I don't know when. After all, I am also quite busy.

notes.title: ABOUT GAME
notes.notes:
Recently, I have also been repeatedly thinking that it would be unwise and impulsive to release games to Steam at this stage. The only thing that can be played with empty game content is the classic initial map and custom mode. I think it's very boring and boring. And there are also model animations and so on. Recently, I have also played some classic 3A games such as the "Dead Space" series and the "Metro" series. I deeply realize how bad my so-called games are. So I decided to remake the game, starting with the model animation. Try new styles and add game systems such as amputation systems. I hope everything will gradually improve in the next update. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: New "skill system" and other updates
notes.notes:
New "skill" system, players can adjust points according to their own needs to obtain the best game attributes
New weapon hit feedback
New flashlight control, players can use the left and right keys of the keyboard to control the left and right of the flashlight
New player injury animation
The player's shooting interface and knapsack interface have been remade, and the text description has been added

notes.title: Add item description system and set new options
notes.notes:
The newly added item description system allows players to obtain detailed item information
New setting option: LOCK PLAYER ROTATION WITH CAMERA. After selection, you can use the mouse to set player rotation
Replace the original ray detection of the pickup center with capsule detection, which increases the range of pickup
Increase the brightness of flashlight and the irradiable angle
The spotlights of the "subway" map in the classic mode have been adjusted, and the final ladder climbing has become black screen transmission

notes.title: New game modes and others
notes.notes:
New game mode - custom mode
Players can define the weapons and difficulty used in the game, as well as the number of monsters and the maximum number generated each time
New setting - reverse Y axis
And a new customized map
